REMIELLE-TEMPORAL_PATTERNS.title: Temporal Patterns
REMIELLE-STILLED_COLORS.title: Stilled Colors
REMIELLE-STILLED_COLORS.description: Whenever you trigger [purple]Refringe[/purple], gain 1 [gold]Voidflare[/gold]. At the start of combat, gain 3 [gold]Voidflare[/gold].
REMIELLE-NAIVE_OATH.title: Naive Oath
REMIELLE-NAIVE_OATH.description: At the start of combat, apply {Lumiflux} [gold]Lumiflux[/gold] to ALL enemies.
REMIELLE-FALL_INTO_THE_NOISE.title: Fall Into the Noise
REMIELLE-THE_GARDEN_OF_DIVERGING_TIME.de: Every 2 turns, draw 1 card at the start of your turn.
REMIELLE-THE_LONG_GOODBYE.title: The Long Goodbye
REMIELLE-THE_LONG_GOODBYE.description: The first [gold]Phase Flow[/gold] card you play each turn is played 1 additional time.
REMIELLE-TO_DRINK_FORGETFULNESS.title: To Drink Forgetfulness
REMIELLE-TO_DRINK_FORGETFULNESS.descript: At the end of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
REMIELLE-LONE_FEATHER_ENDLESS_FLIGHT.des: At the start of your turn, increase your [gold]Feather[/gold] count by 3.
REMIELLE-VOIDWING_PILGRIMAGE.title: Voidwing Pilgrimage
REMIELLE-VOIDWING_PILGRIMAGE.description: Whenever your [gold]Voidflare[/gold] is consumed to 0, gain 1 Energy.
